message: Overall Experience: Paper kafi conceptual tha aur handouts ke un topics se aya tha jinhein aksar ignore kiya jata hai. Sirf past files ya video dekhne se guzara nahi hona tha, handouts ki deep reading lazmi thi. MCQs: MCQs zyada tar handouts ke modules se hi banaye gaye thay. Kuch purani files (Waqar/Junaid) se help mili lekin conceptual sawalat zyada thay. Repeat until distinct. Same core wali states choose karein. States ko merge karein (Union of lookaheads). Successors aur edges ko point/update karein. Pro-Tip for Future Students: Sirf
To add more, to my previous review SDT, DAG are important. Tyari thori aur achi hoti to behtr ho skta tha exam
